plan.title: SRC-AWD-002 — Award and approve one bid

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS, as required for prepared-state cases.
Confirm the comparison grid has exactly one real vendor column.
Verify the sole bid covers the API-held quantity of 10 units.
Verify the sole bid rate matches the API-held bid price of 100.
Verify the bid arithmetic, including 100 × 10 = 1,000 and the matching total.
Allocate the only bid and submit the award proposal in the complete awarding flow.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.need: sign in as the assigned approver, open the submitted proposal from Approvals, enter the remark "OK — QA", and approve it

steps.note: The approval requires a separate approver identity unavailable to the catalog.
Complete PO creation after the award has been approved.
Confirm one PO carries the awarded line with quantity 10.
